subject: SIG questionnaire: request for vulnerability operations proof & scan logs
messages:
From: Lucas Moreno <lucas.moreno@greenmountain.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: compliance@greenmountain.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: SIG questionnaire: vulnerability management artifacts request

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As part of GreenMountain's SIG/CAIQ intake we're looking to verify Redwood's vulnerability management controls for an upcoming risk review. Can you provide: 

- A compact index showing scan cadence (dates + engines) for the last 90 days
- The SLA matrix for CVE remediation tiers and an example attestation for a recently closed Critical/High (CVE ID preferred)
- Sample scan snapshots or a hashed archive (no PII) plus a short explanation of triage routing and ownership
- Any runbook/executive summary that maps detection -> fix -> verification steps we can attach to our SIG response

We need these artifacts by next Thursday (2027-04-29) to meet our auditor timeline. If any of this requires an NDA amendment or you prefer a short walk-through call, happy to schedule.

Best,
Lucas
Lucas Moreno
Senior IT Risk Manager
GreenMountain Finance
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas.moreno@greenmountain.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: vulnerability management artifacts request

Hi Lucas — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a compact evidence packet covering the 90-day cadence and CVE closure examples. Quick notes: 

- We'll provide a CSV index (engine, date, scope, findings hash), a filtered CVE closure log (no exploitable customer data), and a zipped bundle of scans (hash-signed).
- Our internal SLA for remediation is tiered; Criticals get a 14-day hotfix window (emergency patch + PR), Highs are targeted within 45 days, Medium within 90. I'll attach the formal SLO matrix and the runbook excerpt.
- For attestation, Ben will include a redline on a recent Critical remediation we closed last week (CVE-2027-1984) with verifier hashes and deploy IDs.

Deliverables (to confirm): vuln-ops-index.csv, cve-closure-log-20270422.csv, scan-snapshots-20270420.zip, slo-and-runbook.pdf. Delivery ETA: EOD Monday (2027-04-26) so you have time to review before your auditor cutoff.

If you'd like, we can do a 30-minute walk-through of the artifacts early next week.

— Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas.moreno@greenmountain.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: vulnerability management artifacts request

Lucas, Jasmine — attaching the requested artifacts (see attachments). Summary of key points below and a short attestation for CVE-2027-1984.

Summary: 
- Scanners and cadence: We run full external/internal host scans weekly (Qualys), container image scans on build (Trivy) per CI build, and a prioritized daily focus-scan for public-facing endpoints. Index shows last-run timestamps and engine identifier.
- Triage & ownership: High/Blocker alerts route to a dedicated on-call rotation (security-ops@redwood.ai) with automatic paging; owners are tracked in our ticketing system (SEC-#####).
- Verification: Remediation is validated via re-scan + deployment verification hash (CI artefact ID) and logged in the closure CSV.

SLA matrix (excerpt):
- Critical (P1): 14 calendar day hotfix window from detection to deployed fix; emergency patch rollouts supported outside business hours when required.
- High (P2): 45 calendar days to fix + validation.
- Medium (P3): 90 calendar days
- Low: Best-effort; tracked for future releases

Attestation — CVE-2027-1984 (Summary):
- Detection: 2027-04-08 23:12 UTC (Qualys external host scan)
- Triage: Escalated to Security Ops the same day; owner assigned (ticket SEC-2147)
- Fix: Patch applied in service v3.2.1 (PR #5820) — patch merged 2027-04-14
- Verification: Re-scan on 2027-04-16 returned no findings for that CVE; deploy artefact hash: sha256:abc123...; verification ticket SEC-2147-VER closed 2027-04-16
- Evidence: referenced in cve-closure-log-20270422.csv (row for CVE-2027-1984) and scan snapshot included in scan-snapshots-20270420.zip

Attachments included: vuln-ops-index.csv (90-day index), cve-closure-log-20270422.csv (redacted), scan-snapshots-20270420.zip (hash-signed), slo-and-runbook.pdf (runbook excerpt).

If you need signed/letterhead attestation for procurement, we can produce a short signed statement from our security lead — let us know.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel@redwood.ai
To: Lucas Moreno <lucas.moreno@greenmountain.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG questionnaire: vulnerability management artifacts request

Lucas — following up to confirm you received the packet and the attestation example. Quick follow-up items from our side: 

1) Redaction: We redacted internal hostnames and any customer-identifying fields from the CSVs; hashes map to ticket/artefact IDs you can reference.
2) Walkthrough: I'm available Tuesday 2027-05-04 or Wednesday 2027-05-05 for a 30-minute walkthrough to run through the artifacts and show the triage workflow in Jira. Please confirm a time that works.
3) Doc request: If GreenMountain needs the attestation on company letterhead for procurement, I'll coordinate an exec signature — please send the procurement contact and desired language and we'll target that within 48 hours.

Thanks — appreciate the clear timeline.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Security + Trust
Redwood Inference
